name: 3REN
recent: 3REN 近期多次因 ESOS 行使而发行新股，最新一次于 2026 年 11 月 2 日上市。公司于 2026 年 8 月 19 日公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度业绩，营收环比增长 15.2%，但净利环比微降 1.3%。新闻方面，公司被报道正切入 AI 芯片供应链，并看到跨国企业深化槟城布局带来的机会。
notable: 公司因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股，最新一批 10,000 股于 2026 年 11 月 2 日上市。
公司公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度业绩，营收环比增长 15.2%。
媒体报道公司正切入 AI 芯片供应链，并看到跨国企业深化槟城布局带来的机会。
risks: ESOS 行使导致股本逐步扩大，最新已发行股本为 651,676,625 股。
季度净利环比下降 1.3%，同比下降 30.4%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 38,905,000，环比增长 15.2%，同比增长 29.8%；净利为 MYR 3,113,000，环比下降 1.3%，同比下降 30.4%；净利率为 8.0%，低于上一季度的 9.3%。

recent_en: 3REN has issued new shares multiple times recently due to ESOS exercises, with the latest listing on 2 November 2026. The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 19 August 2026, with revenue up 15.2% QoQ but net profit down 1.3% QoQ. In the news, the company was reported to be entering the AI chip supply chain and seeing opportunities from MNCs deepening their Penang footprint.
notable_en: The company issued new shares multiple times due to ESOS exercises, with the latest batch of 10,000 shares listed on 2 November 2026.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 15.2% QoQ.
Media reported that the company is entering the AI chip supply chain and sees opportunities from MNCs deepening their Penang footprint.
risks_en: ESOS exercises have gradually enlarged the share base, with the latest issued share capital at 651,676,625 shares.
Quarterly net profit fell 1.3% QoQ and 30.4% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 38,905,000, up 15.2% QoQ and 29.8% YoY; net profit was MYR 3,113,000, down 1.3% QoQ and 30.4% YoY; net margin was 8.0%, lower than 9.3% in the previous quarter.
